home.news: Jesper Wallstedt has been the NHL's busiest goalie this season, and deservedly so, with consistently stellar play, but Minnesota will turn to Pickard on Saturday in the tail end of a back-to-back. The 34-year-old Pickard, signed in the offseason to back up Wallstedt while Filip Gustavsson (hip) is sidelined, has barely played in 2026-27. He has a 3.50 GAA and .833 SV% in two games (1-1-0) and has not played in two weeks.
